### Deviation: build-then-export ordering (Rule 3 — Blocking)

- **Found during:** Task 1 / Task 2 sequencing
- **Issue:** Plan Task 1 says "regenerate the JSON snapshot", Task 2 says "run npm run build". Vite default `emptyOutDir = true` wipes `dist/` (including `dist/api/`) at build time. If export runs FIRST then build runs SECOND (per plan ordering), the build silently erases the snapshot — exactly the same bug 17.1 gap-closure hit ("First export attempt: collided with subsequent `npm run build` which wiped `dist/`").
- **Fix:** Reversed order locally — ran initial export, ran Vite build (wiped dist/api/), re-ran export from clean state. Final state: 1004 files in dist/api/ + fresh Vite bundle in dist/assets/.
- **Hardening recommendation (Phase 18):** either make `export_api_json.sh` resilient to dist/ wipes by detecting and re-running, OR add a `prebuild` script in `frontend/package.json` that no-ops when dist/api/ is non-empty, OR document the canonical order in `scripts/export_api_json.sh` header.

## GAP-CLOSURE 2026-05-20T22:00Z — UAT Check 5 + 6 fix (frontend-only)

### What Marco saw on the first UAT pass

UAT Check 5 (B1 Tabs 3/4/5) and Check 6 (B2 Tab 2 Triage) failed in the browser
on the Wave 1 deploy. AlertDetailPage's error boundary caught
`TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')` — once
any alert detail tab tried to render, the whole `<AlertDetailPage>` blanked
because the boundary wraps the entire alert detail view. Tab 2 (Triage) was
collateral damage even though Wave 1 (HOTFIX-05) had migrated TriageSection
itself: the boundary catches sibling errors too.

### Root cause — identical contract drift class as 17.2-05-DIAGNOSIS.md

Wave 1 fixed TriageSection only (Path C, narrow scope). The diagnosis
document explicitly flagged out-of-scope:

> EnvironmentSplitSection.tsx (Tab 5) same-class contract drift — flagged
> but not fixed in this plan
> EnvironmentBarChart same-class contract drift — flagged but not fixed
> in this plan
> EnvironmentMetrics interface rename in types/alert.ts — flagged Phase 17.3 candidate

The gap-closure brings forward the type rename PLUS the four sibling
consumers (EnvironmentSplitSection, EnvironmentBarChart, ContributorsSection,
GeoBreakdownSection, GeoBreakdownPieChart). Same producer→consumer drift
on every section:

| Section | Pre-gap consumer read | Wire payload field |
|---|---|---|
| EnvironmentSplitSection | `metrics.revenue / .baseline_revenue / .delta_percent / .bacino / .coverage` | `revenue_current / revenue_baseline / delta_pct / bacino_current / coverage_current` |
| ContributorsSection | `row.publisher_name / .current_revenue / .baseline_revenue / .delta_absolute / .delta_percent` | `display_name / revenue_current / revenue_baseline / delta_eur / delta_pct` |
| GeoBreakdownSection | `row.geo_cluster / .current_revenue / .baseline_revenue / .delta_absolute / .delta_percent / .contribution` | `cluster + cluster_name / revenue_current / revenue_baseline / delta_eur / delta_pct / quota_of_drop` |

Additional landmine surfaced by Rule 1 (auto-fix bugs) discovered ONLY because
the field-rename made the previously-blocked render path reachable:
**`quota_of_drop` is emitted as a percentage 0..100, not a 0..1 fraction**.
Pre-existing `(quota_of_drop * 100).toFixed(1)` would have rendered as
"1057%" / "4487%" — fixed in the same atomic commit chain.

### Gap-closure commit chain

| # | SHA | Subject |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `994ad23` | `fix(17.2-gap): TypeScript types match payload contract for env_split/contributors/geo_breakdown` |
| 2 | `4f9f404` | `fix(17.2-gap): EnvironmentSplitSection + BarChart read payload contract fields, filter amp_drift_detected scalar` |
| 3 | `0a3895c` | `fix(17.2-gap): ContributorsSection reads payload contract fields` |
| 4 | `cbb1621` | `fix(17.2-gap): GeoBreakdownSection + PieChart read payload contract fields` |
| 5 | `eaee9f9` | `fix(17.2-gap): ContributorsSection quota_of_drop scale (percentage, not fraction)` |
| 6 | `74291a1` | `test(17.2-gap): regression pin for alert detail sections × payload contract` |

Each commit was preceded by `npx tsc -b --force` exit 0 verification.
Regression script `scripts/test_alert_sections_payload_contract.py` is
GREEN at HEAD (5 invariants: type contract, source-grep on consumers,
amp_drift_detected guard presence, no quota_of_drop * 100, live snapshot
field-shape probe).
